audit_reference_contract.excluded: No chosen action, narrowed tier, opportunity score, RNG state hash, or game outcome
audit_reference_contract.purpose: Before candidate execution, independently regenerate unchanged canonical roots and action-type counts, require mixed eligibility, and match source B, ordered V4 maximal tier, tier digest and score exactly

candidate_core_constraint.meaning: Existing exhaustive two-action candidate/reference/H are unchanged; no gated-policy wrapper or games in this diagnostic

execution_prerequisite: Separate prospective protocol and exact-head freeze after Worker32 closure as resource_incomplete; this preparation authorizes no execution

observation_contract.board: public visible cells and public placement history only
observation_contract.canonical_encoding: sorted-key compact ensure_ascii JSON, finite numbers only, UTF-8, exactly one trailing newline
observation_contract.collected_equipment: public collected card, one-based action turn, player index
observation_contract.excluded_payloads: No audit tier/scores/chosen move/RNG hash, game result, draw pile, other player's hand, or private set-aside identities
observation_contract.exit_seen: acting player's knowledge in the canonical solo setup
observation_contract.format: Each snapshot JSON and each corpus JSONL row is exactly one serialized PlayerObservation, without an envelope
observation_contract.hand: acting player's own visible card definitions only
observation_contract.set_aside_unplayable: public count only; no private identities

previous_worker32_exclusion.effect: Distinct observation coverage only; all source trajectories/cohorts remain permanently spent
previous_worker32_exclusion.identities_encoding: canonical JSON of sorted [seed, ordinal] pairs, exactly one trailing newline

selection.B_definition: candidate audit legal_move_count; no scorer or legal enumeration is invoked
selection.canonical_revalidation_required: Runner must reconstruct observations and re-enumerate canonical roots/types, verify exact B and COLLECT/PLACE counts and source V4 score/tier before policy calls
selection.collect_count_definition: One per public hand card whose material is raincoat with raincoats < 3, or rope with ropes < 2; metadata arithmetic only
selection.eligibility: collect_count_metadata > 0 and place_count_metadata > 0, excluding every identity in the pinned original Worker32 set
selection.exclusion: Not mixed COLLECT+PLACE, then pinned Worker32 identity set; no outcome, chosen action, score, gain/loss, departure, or terminal-result filter
selection.hash_group: lowest 64 SHA256 keys; ties by ascending seed then ordinal
selection.label: mixed-action-two-action-diagnostic-v1
selection.output_order: hash64 ascending SHA256,seed,ordinal; then stress16 descending cost,ascending seed,ordinal
selection.place_count_definition: recorded B minus metadata COLLECT count; EXIT belongs to PLACE
selection.stress_cost_proxy: B * (B + 1) * C; arithmetic only, not measured successor branching
selection.stress_group: highest 16 cost proxies among remaining states; ties by ascending seed then ordinal
